test_cmd: ls -la src/lib >/dev/null; node_modules/.bin/mocha --require @babel/register --timeout 20000 --reporter xunit --reporter-options output=/out/mocha.xml test/validators.js test/sanitizers.js test/exports.js > /dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
notes: Runs the mocha suite on src/ through @babel/register (repo .babelrc, 'development' env), xunit reporter to /out. test/client-side.js is excluded (it only exercises the prebuilt browser bundle). Only the devDependencies needed by the tests are installed (lint, nyc, rollup, uglify omitted), resolved as of 2019-11-21. BABEL_DISABLE_CACHE avoids stale transpile caches after source injection. Each mocha it() typically covers one validator, so covering-test counts are small.
